title: nothapodytes oblonga
intro: Nothapodytes oblonga, commonly known as the Katki or Tumura, is a plant species in the family Icacinaceae. It is native to the Himalayan region and is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Nothapodytes oblonga include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer properties.
